name: Put Blu Q to Bed — Captain
source: KB: haldo-kb-harvest §1E Put to Bed — Captain; 4.1 Waking up and Putting Blu Q to Bed, Evening > Captain
intro: End-of-day shutdown for Blu Q. Captain handles lines, rinse, engines, and rig. Rinsing away salt is critical to mitigate corrosion on rigging and aluminum. Coordinate dock hose with deckhand.

items.label: Put on overnight lines — slack black stern line to allow tide changes

help.title: Overnight lines
help.body: The black stern line is a backup line if the main stern breaks. Keep it slack to allow for tide changes overnight.

items.label: Grab hose and begin hosing all aluminum beams, anchor, ladder, chain
Hose stainless steel rigging wires, turnbuckles, diamond shrouds, sail hanks/cars

help.title: Why rinse rigging?
help.body: Rinsing away salt is very important to mitigate corrosion on stainless steel rigging components. Do not skip this step.

items.label: Spray down the motors and trim motors
Help scrub or rinse after scrub (depends on day)
Shut off water valve below the meter and lock the hose
Cover GPS and put on blue fabric helm cover
Do log book, note anything important
Message the following captain any status updates
Captain splits tips once all work is done including deckhands
Crew leaves together, last off shuts gate

completion.notes_prompt: Anything the next captain needs to know? Maintenance issues, engine concerns, guest feedback?
